claim: Eight wide parameter bars accept one continuous cross-column gesture. Native LVGL tests verify the exact gesture paths; the user separately confirmed the installed interaction works well. Device captures verify final PCM follows volume commands and saved controls survive installation.

historical_v2.note: The earlier horizontal-slider UI was superseded after user feedback. Its source bytes and original reports remain private historical artifacts; no old report was modified.

limits: Physical usability confirmation is user-reported and separate from the automated host pointer-event proof.
Captures read final device PCM; they do not measure external amplifier/speaker/audio or acoustic level.
Capture maxima and status block peaks refer to different time windows and are not asserted equal.
The short installation/capture sequence is not a sustained GUI/audio stress test or worst-case deadline bound.
Native rendering/pool checks do not measure target execution cost or target heap peak.

The install sequence restored volume4 and its eight saved parameters; the separate read-only post-user snapshot later observes volume2 and user-adjusted parameters. No state after that snapshot is inferred. Oscillator/delay phase and playback history are reconstructed, not restored.

coverage: stationary held input emits no repeated setter
paused suppression across allcolumns and page transitions

post_user_read_only_observation.scope: Subsequent user-adjusted controls are observed, not restored to the earlier install snapshot.
post_user_read_only_observation.source: Read-only snapshot after user confirmed continuous multislider touch works
